pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: house rotated about 10.4 deg (edges run 10 deg below the px x axis); 1-story hip, ridge along the house axis near (640,507) to (696,521) (LiDAR 20 ft, eave 9 to 10 ft); north eave is the line through (600,412) and (660,424): the navy band north of it (y 384-410 at x 600) is the ground shadow of the north wall, confirmed by the county image where the roof spans the same 210 px at x 600; north eave sits higher (about 11 ft) than the south eave (9 ft); the S face is one 5.6/12 plane of about 750 sq ft shared with the W wing; the E end is a vertical fascia at x about 700 from y 430 to 565 then a diagonal clip to the SE corner (674,640); the trace E edge is 2 to 7 ft too far east

pieces.name: w_wing
pieces.notes: 1-story hip wing on the SW, ridge along the house axis near (493,530) to (564,541) (LiDAR 15 ft), hipped at the W end with hips from (431,452) and (421,576) meeting at the ridge; its N face meets the main W face in the valley (564,541) to (516,450); north eave at about y 480 (x 470), not the trace line at y 441: the navy band (446-476) is ground shadow and the white line at 436-441 is the patio wall top (county image shows the same 120 px N-S extent); north eave about 11 ft, south eave 9 ft

exclude_notes: trace north part (y 305 to about 410) is the neighbour house south slope, the gap between the houses and our own north wall shadow; our north eave runs from about (540,400) to (700,432)
shadow band between the trace north edge of the W wing (y 441) and its real north eave (y 480)
strip between the real east fascia (x about 700, vertical, y 430-565, then the diagonal to (674,640)) and the trace east edge: lawn, an AC pad at (705-725,475-500) and tree canopy at the NE
notes: Rotated (10 deg) single-story hip house: main hip with ridge along the axis plus a hip wing on the SW sharing the same south eave and slope. Trace is badly off on the north (neighbour roof plus a 5 to 8 ft wall shadow band on both the main and the W wing) and loose on the east; all excluded, checked against the county image and brightness profiles. Confidence med-high on the two pieces and ridges (LiDAR ridges and hips agree with the image); medium on the exact east edge (vertical in px while the rest of the house is rotated, read from the fascia line and brightness).
